findings.title: Every failed Tibber poll logs an ERROR with traceback, and the outage latch counts two cycles per poll
findings.claim: During a Tibber outage the integration emits one ERROR log record per failed poll (6 over 5 failed polls, expected 1 per transition) and counts 2 outage cycles per poll (10 after 5 polls), so the recovery line reports 'recovered after 10 failed cycle(s)' after 5 failed polls.
findings.mechanism: _tibber_fetch_failed raises UpdateFailed inside _fetch_tibber_prices's own try, whose blanket 'except Exception' (coordinator.py:5465) re-calls _tibber_fetch_failed -- double-counting the latch and re-raising -- and _async_update_data's wrapper except (coordinator.py:4459-4463) then logs _LOGGER.error('Error updating Heat Pump Optimizer: ...', exc_info=True) on every failed cycle, defeating the log-once latch the same function's docstring documents (D10-09).

findings.instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.coordinator:_async_update_data (driven whole; _fetch_tibber_prices reached through the real async_get_clientsession seam with a scripted HTTP 500/200 session) and heatpump_optimizer.coordinator:_tibber_fetch_failed

perturbation.change: coordinator.py:4460 _LOGGER.error('Error updating Heat Pump Optimizer: ...') -> _LOGGER.debug; dry-run on /tmp copy

findings.metric_definition: Log records at level >= ERROR from heatpump_optimizer.* loggers while _async_update_data runs 5 polls whose Tibber POST returns HTTP 500 (rule expects 1), plus _tibber_outage_cycles after them.

null_control.value: 1 INFO record at recovery, 0 ERROR records at recovery
null_control.note: The once-at-recovery half of the rule holds; only the outage side is violated. The recovery poll (HTTP 200) emits exactly one record.

reproduction_steps: Run the harness command in evidence.command
Read RESULT error_logs_during_5_failed_polls (6), outage_cycles_after_5_polls (10), info_logs_at_recovery (1) and the note lines with the record texts

Perturbation dry-run: copy the export to /tmp, change coordinator.py:4460 error->debug, re-run: error count drops to 1; separately re-raise UpdateFailed in _fetch_tibber_prices's except (5465) instead of re-calling _tibber_fetch_failed: outage_cycles drops to 5
findings.proposed_fix_scope: In _fetch_tibber_prices's handlers, re-raise UpdateFailed untouched (if isinstance(err, UpdateFailed): raise) so the latch counts one cycle per poll; demote the _async_update_data wrapper at 4459-4463 to DEBUG (or exempt UpdateFailed) so the per-transition ERROR the _tibber_fetch_failed latch already implements is the only one.
